board: 4-channel infrared tracing / line tracking module, common clone kit: red LM339 control board (4 trimmers, LEDs D1-D5, 6-pin header VCC, GND, IN1, IN2, IN3, IN4) with 4 TCRT5000 probe boards
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test "Line: 0 0 1 1" with probes 1 and 2 set to white, PCB DRC clean, footprint). Modelled as a digital-sensor with four active-low outputs (LM339 open collector, 10k board pull-ups to VCC, low over white); IN1 is openDrain and IN2-IN4 use digitalOutputs; the board is cabled because the probe connectors sit on a second edge.
